trap.label: conector
trap.wrong: Although of the pain, Rui finished the race.
trap.right: Although it hurt, Rui finished the race.
trap.why: Português “apesar da dor” leva substantivo; com although é preciso uma oração, e o brasileiro cria “although of”.

mcq.q: **___** Eva was sick, she cooked dinner.

opts: Although she was upset, she smiled.
Despite she was upset, she smiled.

fix.wrong: Although tired, but Zoe kept dancing.
fix.right: Although she was tired, Zoe kept dancing.

fix.wrong: Despite she was nervous, she sang.
Despite of working late, Ian smiled.

rewrite.prompt: Use despite + -ing: “Although Eva was ill, she cooked.”
Use although: “Despite the heat, Ben waited.” (it was hot)
rewrite.answer: Although it was hot, Ben waited.

rewrite.prompt: Use even though: “Although Lia lost, she laughed.”
rewrite.answer: Even though Lia lost, she laughed.
